creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Wild World Letter Song a biogeography song: continents, islands and mountain belts explain why similarly sized animals never naturally meet, replacing generic safari percussion with a world distribution map.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child draws range shapes and compares convergent roles across continents—lion versus puma, vicuna versus urial, koala versus panda.
